fields.statement: At 03e9795e, TestPickSkipsShipped in internal/daemon/pick_test.go has the three table cases the acceptance names: a succeeded ship-change run after the accept is skipped, a succeeded plan run is picked, and a succeeded ship-change run followed by a reopen is picked. go test ./internal/daemon -run 'TestPickSkipsShipped|TestSkips' -count=1 passed, and go test ./... passed for every package. With go test -overlay mutations of pick.go (the checkout unchanged), each case failed on its own: removing the shipped skip failed the skip case, ignoring Since failed the reopen case, and dropping the workflow check failed the plan case. make check's self-check failed only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor and index files from this run's actor records, not on code.
